Quantized weights of the Minimax H3 Image model, packaged for ComfyUI. Four precision tiers are available so you can pick the right point on the speed/quality / VRAM/RAM curve for your hardware.

About these variants
Four precision levels are available (all sizes are pruned checkpoints), trading VRAM and speed against generation quality:

  • INT8 ConvRot (W8A8): 8-bit weights and 8-bit activations (19.54 GB). Near-lossless quality, runs on INT8 tensor cores (RTX 30-series and up). This is the default recommendation.

  • INT6 (W6A8): 6-bi

description:
MiniMax-H3-Image for ComfyUI: fp8, NVFP4 and GGUF

The precisions of MiniMax-H3-Image that Comfy-Org's ComfyUI repack doesn't

include. These files are the diffusion model only. The text encoder, the VAE

and the bf16, int8 ConvRot and w4a8 versions are at

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image

Versions

- fp8 scaled, 21.0 GB: RTX 40 and RTX 50

- NVFP4, 12.5 GB: RTX 50, the fastest

- GGUF Q6_K 17.5 GB, Q4_K 12.5 GB, Q3_K 10.0 GB: any GPU, through ComfyUI-GGUF

- GGUF Q2_K mix, 9.25 GB: experimental, visibly softer

Requirements

- ComfyUI 0.44 or newer (MiniMax-H3-Image support was added on 10 November 2026)

- Text encoder qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq (or int8convrot) and VAE

minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16, both from Comfy-Org's repository above

- GGUF only: ComfyUI-GGUF must accept the "minimax_h3

title: EMERALD PVC [Checkpoint/Illustrious]
description:
🟩EMERALD PVC

Hey everyone! This model is the result of several merges, created simply to be able to generate images in the desired style.

In the case of this model, it generates images in the PVC Figure/3D style. Sometimes, and depending on the character, the face won't look like a PVC figure, which is why I strongly recommend using the tags pvc and figure. I also recommend using the bokeh tag to give the image a miniature effect.

The character Emerald is just a mascot for this checkpoint, meaning she was not trained directly in the checkpoint and you can make various characters without a problem.

The color filter shown in the images is also just a suggestion, meaning you can reproduce any color filter.

The images used for testing and demonstrating the model were made in Forge NEO, therefore the parameters may change according to the client you use to generate the images.</
